title: patch_file read-first precondition forces expensive read for large index
description: patch_file requires a prior read_file call. For .moeb/signals/index.md (55 KiB, 175 lines), this triggered a result overflow requiring content to be saved to a temp file. The actual patch replaced a single row; the full file read added unnecessary overhead and a new potential failure point.
proposed_resolution: Allow patch_file to operate without a prior read when old_string is uniquely short (e.g., under 500 chars), or provide a grep-and-patch variant that accepts grep-confirmed content without requiring the full file read.
